title: EduFlow Pricing
content: EduFlow offers three plans: Starter at $299/month (up to 50 users, core course library, basic tracking), Growth at $799/month (up to 200 users, full analytics, 40+ integrations, custom learning paths — most popular), and Enterprise with custom pricing (unlimited users, SSO, dedicated CSM, SLA guarantee). Annual billing saves 20%. All plans include a 14-day free trial with no credit card required.

title: EduFlow Integrations
content: EduFlow supports 40+ native integrations including Slack, BambooHR, Workday, ADP, Salesforce, and full REST API access on Growth and Enterprise plans for custom integrations. SCORM 1.2 and 2004 content is also supported.

title: What is EduFlow
content: EduFlow is a corporate learning and development platform that delivers personalised learning paths, real-time progress tracking, and manager insights — all in one platform. It helps companies onboard employees 3x faster, with a 94% course completion rate across 1,200+ companies.

title: EduFlow Features
content: Key features include: AI-powered personalised learning paths, real-time progress analytics dashboards, 500+ course library, 40+ integrations, mobile learning with offline support, compliance tracking and certification management, and manager dashboards.

title: Support and Contact
content: EduFlow support is available Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM EST. Starter plans get email support, Growth plans get priority support, and Enterprise plans receive a dedicated Customer Success Manager with SLA guarantee.

title: Implementation and Setup
content: Most teams are fully set up within one business day. EduFlow handles data migration and provides a dedicated onboarding specialist at no extra cost. Average time-to-first-course is under 4 hours. No IT team required.

title: Course Library
content: EduFlow offers 500+ off-the-shelf courses across business, technology, and compliance. You can also upload your own content — supported formats include SCORM 1.2/2004, video (MP4, Vimeo, YouTube), PDF, PowerPoint, and Google Slides.

title: Mobile Learning
content: EduFlow's mobile app lets employees learn on any device, even offline. Progress syncs automatically when they reconnect. Available on iOS and Android.

title: Analytics and Reporting
content: EduFlow provides real-time dashboards showing completion rates, quiz scores, and skill gaps. Managers get team-level visibility. Export audit-ready reports in one click. CSV reporting on Starter, full analytics on Growth and Enterprise.

title: Compliance Tracking
content: EduFlow offers automated certification management and audit-ready reports for regulated industries. Track mandatory training completion, set renewal reminders, and generate compliance reports instantly.
